title: What does this return?
examObjective: Predicting the result of core DataWeave functions
basics: An `update` path starts from the value it is applied to. `.a` means "the field a of this value", so it only finds something when the value is an Object with an `a` field.
prompt: Read the script. **What does it return?**

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[{ a: 1 }, { a: 2 }] update { case .a -> 5 }

options: It fails: update needs an Object

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[{ a: 1 }, { a: 2 }] update { case .a -> 5 }

explanation.approach: The value is an Array, and an Array has no field `a`, so the case matches nothing and the Array comes back unchanged, with no error. To update a field in every element, `map` over the Array and update each element.

snippets.label: The answer
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[{ a: 1 }, { a: 2 }] update { case .a -> 5 }

snippets.label: Update each element
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[{ a: 1 }, { a: 2 }] map ($ update { case .a -> 5 })
snippets.note: Now every element has a field `a` to change.
